# Adaptate

> Typed, validated data from OpenAPI, JSON Schema, or Zod, including JSON that is still streaming.

Paths are relative to the repository root. There is no deployed documentation site.

## Docs

- [Docs](docs/index.md): Typed, validated data from OpenAPI, JSON Schema, or Zod, including JSON that is still streaming.
- [The adaptate journey](JOURNEY.md): The problem started at Oneflow, where entity schemas did not match across endpoints while I was building features. I wrote the precursor by hand, alone. I wanted to open-source ...
- [Transform](docs/transform.md): One Zod schema, and a config that marks which fields each screen requires.
- [Streaming](docs/streaming.md): Check a tool call while the JSON is still arriving.
- [v3 feeds](docs/v3.md): A makeFeed hook on stream steps, so you can swap in a custom feed without rewriting the parser.
- [AG-UI](docs/ag-ui.md): Check AG-UI TOOL_CALL_ARGS deltas against each view while the JSON is still arriving.
- [Web streams](docs/web-streams.md): Feed a ReadableStream, server-sent events, or a Node stream into the incremental parser.
- [OpenAPI](docs/openapi.md): Turn an OpenAPI schema into Zod, and write a Zod schema back out.
- [Zod](docs/zod.md): Use one Zod schema with a Config per view, and check it through the Standard Schema interface.
- [Effect](docs/effect.md): Run the same checks in an Effect pipeline. Effect is an optional peer.
- [Find your choke points](docs/choke-points.md): Guard the few places where bad or partial data breaks an app, with a Result that keeps an ok track and an error track.
- [TypeScript](docs/typescript.md): Types ship in the npm package. CI checks them on TypeScript 7 and 6.
- [Subpaths](docs/subpaths.md): The published entry points, and which peers each one loads.
- [Optional peers](docs/optional-peers.md): effect, js-yaml, and the ref parser load only when that code is imported. Acceleration packages are separate optional installs.
- [Acceleration](docs/accel.md): Optional native, WASM, and GPU packages for large buffers, kept off the default zero-dep install.
- [Runtime verification](docs/verification.md): Fail-closed in-memory hooks that verify a buffer before any bytes are written to disk.
- [Migration 2.4](docs/migration-2.4.md): YAML and the ref parser became optional peers between 2.3 and 2.4.
- [Migration 3.0](docs/migration-3.0.md): v3 is additive: makeFeed, @adaptate/core/verify, and optional acceleration packages, with the default install still zero-dep.
- [Development](docs/development.md): Install, test, and build this repository with pnpm.
